entities.summary: Marie-Louise Ester Maude Ekman, née Fuchs, and known during her first marriage under the surname De Geer, and during and after her second as De Geer Bergenstråhle is a Swedish painter and film director. She is a professor of art and former rector at the Royal University College of Fine Arts, Stockholm.
